analogue: Gas-phase isoprene epoxydiol reactive uptake onto sulfate-containing aerosol.
citation: Reactive Uptake of an Isoprene-Derived Epoxydiol to Submicron Aerosol Particles
evidence: Gaston et al. measured over 500-fold greater uptake on ammonium bisulfate than on ammonium sulfate, where the coefficient was at most 10⁻⁴.
difference: V_I is not measured IEPOX, and Manchester supplied nominally neutral sulfate. Acidity, organic coating, available surface and gas-phase precursor abundance control whether uptake contributes.
